facts.text: Base is the multi-agent environment base class; users start from it, add environment modules and stack wrappers on top
The repository depends on the separate mujoco-worldgen package, must install it and its requirements before this package, and was tested only on Mac OS X and Ubuntu 16.04 with Python 3.6
The Base constructor defaults are horizon 250, n_substeps 5, n_agents 2, floor_size 6.0, grid_size 30 and action_lims (-1.0, 1.0), with deterministic_mode False
n_substeps is the number of internal MuJoCo steps per outer environment step, described as action repeat
Base passes tuple(action_lims) as the action_space, horizon and deterministic_mode to the mujoco-worldgen Env constructor
The world parameters use size (floor_size, floor_size, 2.5) and num_substeps n_substeps
The episode draws floor_size uniformly from floor_size_dist, builds each attempt with WorldBuilder(world_params, seed) and returns builder.get_sim()
The hide-and-seek factory defaults are n_substeps 15, horizon 80, floor_size 6.0, grid_size 30 and action_lims (-0.9, 0.9)
The hide-and-seek factory constructs Base with n_hiders + n_seekers agents
The hide-and-seek factory stacks SplitMultiAgentActions, AgentAgentObsMask2D, an observation wrapper, a reward wrapper, PreparationPhase and DiscretizeActionWrapper on Base

determinism.notes: Base passes a seed to WorldBuilder in _get_sim (mae_envs/envs/base.py:77) and accepts deterministic_mode (mae_envs/envs/base.py:29); the package's fake draws its start state from Python's random.Random(seed), so the trajectory repeats for one seed on the fake only

gaps: the fake is a reduced pure Python stand-in for Base and hide_and_seek:make_env: it does not model MuJoCo contacts, the module stack, the reward wrappers or the observation dictionaries, and its dimensions and integration constants are placeholders

the pinned clone does not state the MuJoCo physics timestep: n_substeps is the number of internal steps per outer step (mae_envs/envs/base.py:18-19) and the timestep lives in mujoco-worldgen, so timestep_ms is 0 and no simulated duration is claimed

the pinned clone does not state the raw action dimension: Base passes the two-tuple action_lims to mujoco-worldgen, which builds the Box from the simulation's actuators (mae_envs/envs/base.py:31-35); the fake uses two action values per agent as a placeholder
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance the fake only
the environment is the system of record; no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
snapshot and restore are not offered: the pinned clone exposes no get_state/set_state
no rendering: the upstream viewer needs mujoco_py and is not modelled

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
